decisions.reason: Having survived its first year and fitting the firm’s established laser portfolio, it is likely above minimum aspiration and worth retaining given the firm’s slack and service-intensive installed-base logic.

As a close-to-core thermal inkjet printer that broadens the firm’s single-source coding offer, management would usually keep it unless results clearly fall below aspirations, which is not indicated here.

This piezo inkjet printer carries somewhat higher withdrawal risk because it may face niche demand or overlap with other high-resolution options, but the growing firm’s slack and learning orientation still favor retention.
Because this 2024 laser line is presented as a flagship direction and aligns closely with the firm’s Industry 4.0 traceability strategy, management is very unlikely to pull it so soon.
The compact laser marking cabin reinforces the firm’s broader laser workstation family, so without evidence of a serious performance shortfall it would be kept to support portfolio completeness.
Although it serves a more specialized application, the trade-fair award is a strong positive signal that results may meet or exceed aspirations, making withdrawal unlikely.
